dialog.english:
Morning! Sora, what's wrong?
What's with the long face...
dialog.translation:
¡Buenas! Sora, ¿qué te pasa?
Vaya cara larga...

dialog.english:
Sorry for calling you over so
early in the morning.

I thought maybe I'd just say that
I can't go to soccer practice
today and leave it at that, but...
dialog.translation:
Pensaba decirte que hoy no
puedo ir al entreno de fútbol
y ya está, pero...

dialog.english:
Did something happen? And you just
started playing again after all
this time...
dialog.translation:
¿Ha pasado algo? Si acababas de
volver a jugar después de
tanto tiempo...

dialog.english:
This morning, my mom asked me to
do something for her...
dialog.translation:
Esta mañana mi madre me ha
pedido un favor...

dialog.english:
She really does hate me playing
soccer.
Sora...

I'm sorry, Tai. Please tell the
coach for me...
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, Tai. Díselo al
entrenador de mi parte...

dialog.english: Now that that's settled, bye...
Hey! Sora!
Hey! Sora!
I'm glad we got that over with.

All Mom said was that she needed a
bunch of flowers.
dialog.translation:
Mamá solo dijo que necesitaba
un ramo de flores.

dialog.english:
(She could have easily told me
this on the phone, so why...?)
dialog.translation:
(Eso me lo podía haber dicho
por teléfono. ¿Por qué...?)

dialog.english:
If you hurry, you can still make
it to practice.
dialog.translation:
Si te das prisa, aún llegas
al entreno.

dialog.english:
You're right, Yokomon. Let's
hurry.
Sora, a Digimon!

Really?! What's it doing in front
of the florist?
dialog.translation:
¡¿En serio?! ¿Qué hace delante
de la floristería?

dialog.english:
Doesn't look like it's searching
for the eighth Chosen Child...
dialog.translation:
No parece que esté buscando
al octavo Niño Elegido...

dialog.english: for the eighth Chosen Child...
*muttering*
*muttering*
It's muttering something.
Let's sneak up and listen in.

Ah, so many cuties that I've never
seen before, not even in the
Digimon world!
dialog.translation:
¡Ah, cuántas monadas que no
había visto nunca, ni en el
Digimundo!

dialog.english:
Selling them to humans in a place
like this...
dialog.translation:
Venderlas a los humanos en
un sitio así...

dialog.english: in a place like this...
Cuties, he said.

I wonder if he's talking about the
flowers for sale here.
dialog.translation:
¿Hablará de las flores que
venden aquí?

dialog.english:
I wonder if he's talking about the
flowers for sale here.
dialog.translation:
¿Hablará de las flores que
venden aquí?

dialog.english:
I, Veggiemon, will rescue these
captive cuties!
dialog.translation:
¡Yo, Veggiemon, liberaré a
estas monadas presas!

dialog.english:
"You're so amazing, Mr.
Veggiemon", they'll say! I'll be
so popular!
dialog.translation:
¡"Qué maravilla, señor
Veggiemon", dirán! ¡Voy
a ser popularísimo!

dialog.english:
Treat the plants well! Free the
cuties!
Free the cuties!

Look at him! He's only gonna be
popular in his own mind!

At this rate, he'll cause the
florist a lot of trouble! We have
to stop him!
dialog.translation:
¡Así va a causarle problemas a
la floristería! ¡Hay que
pararle!

dialog.english:
But Sora, you'll miss your morning
practice.
dialog.translation:
Sora, te perderás el
entreno de la mañana.

dialog.english:
This isn't the time to be worrying
about this! Let's go, Yokomon!
dialog.translation:
¡No hay tiempo para preocuparse
por eso! ¡Vamos, Yokomon!

dialog.english: Let's go, Yokomon!

We heard everything you said! We
won't let you attack the florist!
dialog.translation:
¡Lo hemos oído todo! ¡No vamos a
dejar que ataques la floristería!

dialog.english:
Gh, I got caught. Oh well. I'll
just have to beat you up!
dialog.translation:
Ghh, me pillasteis. ¡Da igual,
os voy a dar una paliza!

dialog.english: Let's go!
*whew*
Sora, did you see that?
You did great, Yokomon!
Eheheh!
Sora! Are you okay?!
Mom!

I heard there was a child with a
strange stuffed animal causing a
riot in front of the flower shop.
dialog.translation:
Me dijeron que un niño con un
peluche raro montó un lío
frente a la floristería.

dialog.english:
I was worried you might have
gotten caught up in it...
dialog.translation:
Me preocupaba que te hubieras
visto envuelta...

dialog.english:
Yeah, I'm fine. I finished what
you asked me to do.
dialog.translation:
Sí, estoy bien. Ya hice lo
que me pediste.

dialog.english:
Sorry for putting you in such a
dangerous situation, Sora. I
didn't mean to.
dialog.translation:
Perdona por ponerte en una
situación peligrosa, Sora. No
era mi intención.

dialog.english: Mom...

All I wanted was for you to
understand a flower arrangement
school head's job a little.
dialog.translation:
Solo quería que entendieras
un poco el trabajo de una
maestra de arreglos florales.

dialog.english: Yeah...
Anyway, let's go home.
Okay.

Your mom was worried about you,
Sora.
dialog.translation:
Tu madre se preocupó
por ti, Sora.

dialog.english: Yeah...
Aren't you happy, Sora?

Sorry, sorry! Don't worry about
me. Come on, let's go home!
dialog.translation:
¡Perdón, perdón! No te preocupes
por mí. ¡Va, vamos a casa!
